_vocabulary: Every key under templates[].thresholds MUST be one of the six in lib/sandbox/competencies.ts: ai_prompt_literacy, task_accuracy, customer_comms, data_tools, process_thinking, adaptability. A threshold on any other key can never be met, so the template matches nobody and the SME sees an empty list with nothing logged.
